headline: Phillies walk off Expos on ninth-inning error
recap: Larry Bowa led off the bottom of the ninth with a single against Montreal reliever Elias Sosa, then came around to score the winning run with two outs after Bake McBride reached on a fielding error by Expos first baseman Tony Perez, giving the Phillies a 4-3 win over Montreal.
Dick Ruthven started for Philadelphia and allowed two runs on five hits over six innings; Montreal's Steve Rogers went the first seven, allowing three runs on seven hits.

Ron Reed relieved Ruthven to start the seventh and surrendered the tying run that inning before working two more scoreless frames to pick up the win. In the ninth, after Bowa's leadoff single and a force play put him on third with two outs, Sosa intentionally walked Mike Schmidt to load the bases before McBride's grounder got past Perez.
